name: Blender Cheesecake
directions: Place all the ingredients into a blender on high and blend until well incorporated and creamy
If batter looks a little too thick, add 1 TBSP of heavy cream
Line parchment paper in a 6 in round cake pan
Bake for about 30 to 35 minutes and for a golden top, broil for about 50 seconds
Take Cheesecake out of the oven and cool for about 20 minutes or until the pan is not hot
Serve or leave in fridge overnight for a more firm texture
